Remove ONLY every text glyph in image: 'Back', 'MY DECKS', game name upper-right, NEW DECK and its subtitle, IMPORT DECK and its subtitle, OPEN DECK FOLDER, note under buttons, Saved on this device. This must match reference exactly except removed UI lettering so native live labels can be placed over it. Output full same-aspect landscape image.
